description: Custodian of a store: receives, issues, moves and sets aside stock; prepares counts and internal use; stock reports and labels
cannot: Count blind; inspect goods; order; approve write-offs; post invoices or payments

description: Counts stock blind (no book quantities) and submits counts
cannot: See book quantities; receive or issue stock; post counts

description: Inspects goods received: accepts or rejects each line with a reason
cannot: Receive or issue stock; order; pay

description: Raises requisitions and LPOs; maintains suppliers and their pre-qualification; checks budgets
cannot: Receive or inspect goods; post supplier invoices; pay

description: Records receipts: cash, cheque, M-Pesa and bank transfers
cannot: Post invoices or journals; pay suppliers; reconcile the bank

description: Prepares journals, supplier and customer invoices and payments; bank statements, matching and reconciliation; budgets, opening balances, asset register and tags; prepares the board pack
cannot: Receive cash; approve own journals and payments (second-person rules); approve budgets, sign off opening balances or approve the board pack

description: Approves: completes journals and payments prepared by others, approves budgets, signs off opening balances, closes audit queries, approves write-offs, reverses documents; maintains approval rules and reasons
cannot: Receive cash; order; keep stores; approve the board pack

description: Reviews and approves the board finance committee pack for release
cannot: Prepare the pack; post or approve transactions

description: Verifies assets in the field and records results for the board of survey
cannot: Keep the asset register; tag assets
